claims.text: Mark S. Zaid was attorney of record for the plaintiff in Danny B. Stillman v. Department of Energy, United States District Court for the District of Columbia, Civil Action No. 01-01342 (EGS), and stated in his declaration of 16 August 2001 that he specialises in litigating national security cases including those involving the First Amendment.
